parsed.explanation: No state bathroom ban or presentation offence, and the 2016 law was repealed, is a real traveller positive. It is outweighed by the enforced parent regime: binary passport policy allowed to take effect, entry screening treating document discrepancy as possible fraud, federal facility exclusion, and documented severe harm in national/immigration custody including hormone removal and abuse. Within the state there is no statewide public-accommodations or hate-crime recourse for gender identity—only municipal coverage for about 30% of the population—so service denial or bias assault has thin remedy. Courts have enjoined some federal orders, mitigating but not curing the universal document/facility exposure. The trans-women killing figure is an acknowledged undercount floor with no general-homicide comparison, so it was not used as a rate.
